test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Although our new boss knew he was wrong, he was too__** obstinate**__ to accept that.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"obstinate"** means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so. (हठी)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite the evidence presented, he remained obstinate in his beliefs.
 
 
 
• **"Flexible" **refers to someone or something that is willing to change or adapt. It is the ability to be easily modified and responsive to different circumstances. (लचीला)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a flexible approach to problem-solving, which makes her an excellent leader.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'obstinate' **is **'flexible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Flexible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fearless **(निर्भय): Lacking fear.

 
 
• **Example:** The firefighter was fearless in the face of danger.
 
 
 
• **Adamant **(अडिग): Refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind.
 
 
• **Example: **She was adamant about not going to the party.
 
 
 
• **Competent** (कुशल): Having the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something successfully.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a competent worker who always meets his deadlines.
